candidate.user_submission: Pikin na 18 months old. E get diarrhoea for 3 days. E still dey get diarrhoea. E no dey get cough or wahala to breathe. E no dey get fever. E dey get ear problem. Di pikin no dey convulse now. E never get convulsion before. E no dey weak or unconscious. E fit drink or suck breast. E no dey vomit everything wey e chop. Dem no see blood for e stool. E dey drink water or breast but e no too sabi drink well. E no dey restless or dey irritable. When dem pinch e skin, e skin return normal. E get sunken eyes. E no dey get ear discharge. E no dey get ear pain. E no pus dey come out from e ear. E get swelling wey dey pain am for back of e ear.
